summary: NocoDB is a self-hosted Airtable-like no-code database platform: its own metadata (bases, sources, models/tables, columns, views, users, workspaces, webhooks, integrations) is persisted in nc_* meta tables, and it writes/reads the actual user row data in configured source DBs via knex. Mined the CE metamodel CRUD, the data-row read/write path, auth/users/tokens, and the delivery/audit layer.
